You are a literature/adaptation AUTHOR, not the acceptance reviewer. User requested absorbing /mnt/c/Users/HuangZY/Downloads/absorption_plan.md and selected_references.bib into the SL project via workflow2.0.1. Read them and /mnt/f/LaTeX/BVE research/AGENTS.md. ONLY write under /mnt/f/tools/sl-literature-absorption-20260923/author-interfaces, create/maintain AGENTS.md. Read current sources without modifying project/plugin/library/canonical/history. No commits or remote writes.
Own L10,L11 and bounded P3 absorption. Retrieve PRIMARY arXiv/author/publisher texts and metadata. Preserve actual URLs, response status/time, raw/text hashes, exact reading coverage and page/theorem/equation references. Inspect original formulas where extraction is unclear. Full source originals remain private in your write area; public proposed content should be original concise theorem notes and own project derivations, not full copyrighted papers.
Read current research/artifacts/proof-audit-round9-20260923/analytic-repair.md and tools/second-variation-weighted-eigenvalues.md, plus actual relevant current spectral/transfer sources. Respect round9 corrected normalization kernel component, finite one-dimensional reduced Green kernel, signed mass convergence, half-gap factor, interface acceleration and G1' remaining open.
Precisely map Latushkin-Sukhtaiev fixed symmetric-operator C2 extension path assumptions to the moving-density interface problem: record the real missing bridge instead of silently assuming it. Map Eckhardt-Teschl measure coefficients and explain Radon delta versus delta-prime, topology of concentration and what it does not imply. Develop a rigorously bounded project interface chain-rule theorem under explicit proved/conditional analytic assumptions, and an exact or analytic single-interface/constant-density calibration against direct transfer matrices if feasible. Keep fixed-density Hessian, eigenfunction normalization, path acceleration and admissible directions separate. No global sign or uniqueness claims.
Deliver two original source-to-claim notes, 1-3 proposed tool-card JSONs (title/summary/conditions/scope/evidence_status/content/sources), own derivation/test evidence, source-manifest.json and REPORT.md. Actual execution evidence required for numerical checks; analytical hypotheses must remain visible. No subdelegation; fresh independent reviewer supplied by coordinator. Return exact written paths/hashes, actual coverage and unresolved applicability gaps.
